name: Mind Blast
text: You take the same amount of damage you dealt. + Switch two unknown tiles. If you beat the creature's Stats at known tiles, you may switch known tiles.

spell.usage: WBC3 spell-cast sound paired with the EZ effect; play when the effect is cast

data.text: You take the same amount of damage you dealt. + Switch two unknown tiles. If you beat the creature's Stats at known tiles, you may switch known tiles.

logic.description: Reworked 2026-10-29 (switch). With an enemy in contact: Concentration point-buy damage to the enemy and the same to me. With no enemy in reach: the left-clicked tile and my tile swap everything on them — units, traps, obstacles, feature tokens (the owners move their things at resolution).

prerequisites.description: An instant rides on any action (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
The left-clicked tile lies within 10 hexes of the caster (general_ux_range_cast_target); none chosen → the engine picks (random / nearest).

effects.description: Rule 20: one point-buy per emission on the caster stat behind the element going out; this is the total number of d6 the whole cast rolls (6·n nearest the stat, ties to more dice).
Σ of the kept dice (one per element, the highest die of each successful roll) ÷10, rounded half up; a failed roll re-emits only that element (cast status retry).
The caster suffers exactly the damage it dealt (0 when nothing landed).
No enemy in reach → my tile and the chosen tile exchange their units, traps, obstacles and tokens.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_concentration (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
